_readme: Registry of the identifiers the engine knows how to resolve.
This is the shared contract: the engine (Ruby), the views (JS) and the validator all read THIS file.
A card using a value not listed here is rejected at validation time, not at runtime.
Adding a value here is a design decision: it commits the engine to resolving it.
Rules source: docs/MANUALE.md (Italian). Card terms map as:
Flux=Flusso, HP=PV, Fury=Furia, Entity=Entita, Power=Potenza, Matter=Materia,
Nexus=Nexus, Recall Zone=Zona di Richiamo, Front=Fronte, Abyss=Abisso,

keyword._note: Keyword abilities with rules predefined by the manual (MANUALE.md §8.1)

event._note: Moments that fire a trigger on_deal_damage: la carta (Entità) infligge danno in combattimento a un Rubyfront; details.toRubyfront limita al bersaglio Rubyfront. on_assign_object: il controllore assegna un Oggetto (details.toSelf limita alla carta stessa). on_draw_card: il controllore pesca una carta.

effect._note: Effect types the engine must be able to resolve assign_object: assegna Oggetti a Entita' senza pagarne il costo salvo indicazione. reduce_cost: sconto sul costo di Flusso di carte future (details.nextPlayedThisTurn). modify_counterattack: modifica il Contrattacco (amount additivo o setTo). gain_control: il controllore prende il controllo del bersaglio per la durata indicata; alla scadenza torna al proprietario. restrict_action: impedisce al bersaglio una specifica azione (details/restricts: attack, block, play) per la durata indicata. restricts play con duration permanent e details.followsCard segue la carta in ogni zona (mano, mazzo, Ritiro, Abisso): non puo' piu' essere giocata per il resto della partita. prevent_tap: il bersaglio non viene mai tappato — non dall'attacco (§6.3), non dal blocco, non da un effetto (RBF-011).

timing._note: Windows in which an action may be activated (MANUALE.md §6) own_post_combat: dopo la risoluzione del combattimento del proprio turno, fino alla fine del turno.

state._note: States an Entity can be in (MANUALE.md §6.3). 'covered' blocks every action and suspends its Matters

zone._note: Game zones (MANUALE.md §5). Ownership is expressed with 'owner', never baked into the zone name. 'abyss' holds dead/consumed cards, 'retire' holds cards that left the game alive (retired Entities and their Objects). Removed-from-game is NOT a zone (MANUALE.md §10)

zoneOwner._note: Who the referenced zone belongs to. 'card_owner' is the owner of the card involved, which is not necessarily the player resolving the effect

duration._note: How long a continuous effect lasts

matterBehavior._note: How a Matter card behaves when played (MANUALE.md §7.2). Field 'behavior' on matter faces; 'normal' carries no label on the printed card

die._note: Dice the engine must know how to roll: costi di schieramento a dado (MANUALE.md §3.1) e tiri delle parole chiave come Furia (§8.1). Il d20 e' il massimo: oltre non esisterebbe un costo sempre pagabile entro il tetto di 20 Flussi

matter._note: Matter types (MANUALE.md §7.1). Dynamic, dimensional and destructive have grades 1-2; zero and dominant have none

cardType._note: Card types. The Rubyfront is its own type: it is not an Entity

match._note: How multiple conditions combine: field 'match', alongside 'conditions'

operator._note: How a value is compared: field 'operator', alongside 'stat' and 'value'
